title: viola tricolor subsp. machadeana
intro: Viola tricolor subsp. machadeana, commonly known as Pansy Violet, is a subspecies of the Heartsease plant, which is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Violaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Viola tricolor subsp. machadeana include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful for treating skin conditions, wounds, and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
